tools.name: list_components
tools.description: This tool retrieves the names of all available PLASMA components.

tools.name: get_installation_guide
tools.description: This tool retrieves the Plasma installation and setup guide. It describes how to hook a theme and tokens.

tools.name: get_nextjs_guide
tools.description: This tool retrieves the Plasma guide for connecting the library in a Next.js project.

tools.name: get_functions
tools.description: This tool retrieves the combined description of imported Plasma hocs, hooks, mixins, and utils from the functions section.

tools.name: get_design_system_configuration
tools.description: This tool retrieves the combined Plasma design system configuration, including typography, colors, and spacing documentation.

tools.name: get_form_guide
tools.description: This tool retrieves the combined Plasma form guides for native HTML forms, React Hook Form, and component support in these forms.

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: This tool retrieves the list of Plasma tokens that can be reused in custom components.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: This tool provides complete information about any Plasma component, including properties, design props (size, variant, etc.), attributes, configuration options, and practical implementation examples—from basic usage to advanced scenarios with complete code snippets.

tools.name: get_component_props
tools.description: This tool provides comprehensive details about a specific Plasma component, including its properties, design-related props (such as size and variant), attributes, and available configuration options.

tools.name: get_component_examples
tools.description: This tool retrieves example code and usage patterns with complete code snippets. Access practical implementation examples for any Plasma component: from basic usage to advanced configurations and common use cases.
